'''HoloNet News Vol. 531''' was [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition's]] 531st volume of circulation. It was released in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and ran for 12 issues.

==Behind the scenes==
Part of this volume was released as [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]], an [[in-universe]] website created in [[2002]] to publicize the then-upcoming [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] film.
